checks.name: routing-and-exclusive-closure
argv:
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.run_ci_pack import infer_job_scopes, load_legacy_jobs, select_jobs, curated_exclusive_closure_findings
import json
manifest=Path(".github/ci/legacy-jobs.yml")
jobs,summary=infer_job_scopes(load_legacy_jobs(manifest,gate="code"))
print(json.dumps({"scope_summary":summary}),flush=True)
pairs=[
("tests/test_build_site_frozen_us_source.py","unrun-grading-board"),
("tests/test_render_macro_fast_source_guard.py","unrun-grading-board"),
("scripts/build_site.py","unrun-grading-board"),
("scripts/render_macro_fast.py","unrun-grading-board"),
("tests/test_prophet_public_featured_access_card.py","prophet-lab"),
("templates/dashboard.html.j2","prophet-lab"),
("templates/theme.css","prophet-lab"),
("tests/test_prophet_same_date_publication.py","washout-turn-organ"),
("scripts/build_prophet.py","washout-turn-organ"),
("site/prophet/index.json","washout-turn-organ"),
]
for changed_path,owner in pairs:
 selected,reason=select_jobs(jobs,[changed_path])
 ids={job.job_id for job in selected}
 assert owner in ids,(changed_path,owner,reason)
 print(json.dumps({"changed_path":changed_path,"required_owner":owner,"owner_selected":True,"selected_count":len(ids),"reason":reason}),flush=True)
findings=curated_exclusive_closure_findings(manifest)
print(json.dumps({"canonical_exclusive_closure_findings":findings,"qualified_changed_exclusive_owner":"washout-turn-organ","changed_owner_passed":"washout-turn-organ" not in findings}),flush=True)
assert "washout-turn-organ" not in findings,findings["washout-turn-organ"]
